title: feat(plugin-security, runtime, metadata-protocol, core)!: the permission-set grant, clone and activation doors take a package, and a grant is unique per package
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBThgU55XJqPRA54ajb3R55x)_ Fixes #32164 Clause-②: no (narrowing) - Widening, at the grant, clone and activation doors: a permission set two packages hold, addressed with no package: FROM read as absent (the grant's `400 reference_not_found`, the clone and activation doors' `404`) TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holders; addressed with a package that holds it (`permission_set_package` on the grant, `?package=` on clone and activation): FROM the package dropped TO exactly that package's set. - Narrowing (F3), a named package that does not hold the set, at any holder count: FROM the grant re-stamped to the holder (one holder) or stored with no package (two holders), a system column-only bind landing as written, and `?package=` dropped at the clone and activation doors (one holder: the holder's set) TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, naming the holders, with nothing stored or switched. - Narrowing, the clone and activation doors' query sets are closed: FROM any query parameter dropped without a word TO `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before any lookup for anything but `package`, and for `package` on an activation type other than `permission`, repeated or blank. - Narrowing, a clone target name two packages hold: FROM free (the reader answers nothing for a refused name, so the copy was saved) TO taken, `409`, as a name one package holds already was. Metadata-protocol: none A writer that meets the F3 refusal names a package the refusal lists, or none. Each moved answer, door by door, is in the changeset. No first-party writer or caller meets any of the three narrowings: the boot backfill and `os migrate stored-references bind` write only a holder, and the Console sends no query to these doors. ## 维护者速读 1. 改了什么：给用户授权权限集、开关权限集（激活入口）、克隆权限集这三个入口，现在都能用 `permission_set_package` / `?package=` 指明"哪个包的那一个"；同名权限集由两个包持有时，不指明包就拒绝（409）并列出两个候选包。授权的唯一键加上了包这一列，另由一条运行时守卫保证"不带包的授权"仍然是一人、一个权限集、一个组织只有一条。 2. 为什么改：ADR-0150 允许不同包各有一个同名权限集（#31698 PR-2 之后真正会出现），而这三个入口原来只按名字找，遇到同名要么答"不存在"（404/400），要么存错包；这张卡先把入口和唯一键准备好，PR-2 才能落地。 3. 风险与回滚：只有一个包持有、且不指明包或指明持有包时，三个入口的回答逐字节不变（16 项回答已对照 main 的源码，md5 一致）。收紧三处：指明一个并不持有该权限集的包会被拒绝（以前静默改写成持有包或照存）；两个入口的查询参数只认 `package`，其它参数回 400；克隆目标名若被两个包持有算已占用。第一方没有任何调用会碰到。旧的三列唯一索引只在守卫建成后才退役（18.0 升级库里它是 COALESCE 形式，只在已认证的库上退役，否则一直保留），绝不被当作孤儿索引删除；守卫建不起来（已有重复授权）时只在日志里点名重复的键，不删、不改任何授权。回滚即还原本 PR。 4. 先看：`stored-permission-set-package-stamp.ts`（F3 拒绝，`assertNamedPackageHolds`）、`user-permission-set-packageless-index.ts`（守卫与冲突报告）、`catalog-activation.ts`（`?package=` 定址与台账行）。 5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/permission-set-package-doors.test.ts`，预期 14 个全过：两个包持有时不带包回 409 并带两个候选，`?package=` 指 HR 回 200 并写 HR 的台账行。 6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **The grant** (`plugin-security`): `grant-permission-set-name.ts` judges a non-system writer's grant through the security catalog by `(package, name)` (`judgeGrantSet`): a set two packages hold, named with no package, is refused with core's `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, 409, the D3 sentence, `.refusal.candidates`); a named holder is kept; a named non-holder is refused (`not-held-by-qualifier`). `stored-permission-set-package-stamp.ts` keeps a named package that holds the set for every writer and refuses one that does not (`assertNamedPackageHolds`), on insert, on update and on a column-only bind; it never re-stamps a named package. Before the boot seals the holders, a system insert's named package is kept unjudged (the backfill reads a stale one as none). - **The activation door** (`runtime`, `catalog-activation.ts`): `?package=PKG` addresses exactly PKG's set and writes its ledger row naming PKG; two holders and no package answer `409` with `details.candidates`; a non-holder is `409 not-held-by-qualifier`; the query set is closed (`package`, for `permission` only). The ledger store still keeps one row per `(metadata_type, name)` (ADR-0150 red line 3, see Acceptance notes). - **The clone door** (`runtime`, `permission-set-clone.ts`): `?package=` names the SOURCE's package (the body's `package` still names where the copy lands); two holders and no package answer `409` with `details.candidates`; a target name two packages hold is taken; the query set is closed. - **core** (`security-catalog.ts`): the refused arm of `SecurityCatalogResolution` gains an optional `holders`, the candidates structured, so a door can answer them without re-deriving. Additive. - **The grant's key** (`objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`): `(user_id, permission_set, organization_id)`, `unique: 'organization'` → `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)`, `unique: 'global'`. - **The package-less guard** `uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless` keeps grants that name no package to one per `(user_id, permission_set, organization_id)`: - SQL: `metadata-protocol/src/migrations/user-permission-set-packageless-index.ts`, built at `kernel:ready` beside the activation ledger's guard (a partial index on SQLite and PostgreSQL, a functional key part on MySQL 8.0.13+, an INVISIBLE generated `__hash` column on MariaDB 10.3+). It is in the runtime-index preflight roster, so `os migrate duplicates` lists it. - Mongo: `driver-mongodb`'s `RUNTIME_OWNED_UNIQUES` gains the same key with `permission_set_package: null`. - It is re-runnable and guesses no package: on existing duplicates the build fails and logs, at `error`, the duplicated keys (up to ten, then a count), the consequence and the listing query; nothing is deleted or re-stamped, and the next boot tries again. - The old three-column index retires only once the guard stands (driver-sql's existing widening arm: one safe `replace_unique_index`; driver-mongodb in the same sync). - `driver-memory`: a declared limit, measured and pinned (Acceptance notes). - **`driver-sql`, the differ's widening arm** (`schema-drift.ts`), found by the first full dogfood run (see Verification): - It now also matches the narrower key as an 18.0 database built it, with the tenant key part in the NULL-safe form (`UNIQUE (user_id, permission_set, COALESCE(organization_id, '__global__'))` under the same generated name, `uniq_sys_user_permission_set_ac248331`). Before, that index read as an orphan: `drop_index`, categorized `destructive`. - On a certified table (ADR-0131 D1: the tenant column holds no NULL, the reading the 7b-1 equivalence already makes) it is kept until the guard stands, then offered as the one `safe` replace. On a table that is not certified it is kept and nothing is offered, because the COALESCE bucket also keeps NULL-organization grants to one, which neither the wider key nor the guard does. - A gained column not yet physical (`os migrate plan` read before the sync that adds `permission_set_package`) keeps the narrower too, instead of leaving it to the orphan arm. - Docs: `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (the grant's package, the clone door's `?package=`) and `authorization.mdx` (the activation door's `?package=`). ## Why ADR-0150 D3/D5/D8, a child of #31527 ahead of #31698 PR-2. Once two packages can each hold a permission set of one name, a door that addresses a set by bare name must either be told which one or refuse naming both; a grant must record which one it grants, and the grant's key must let one user hold both. These doors answered a two-holder name as absent (404, or the grant's 400 `reference_not_found`) and dropped `?package=`, and a grant's named package was re-stamped rather than judged. This PR makes every door take the package and refuse the ambiguity with its candidates, so PR-2 can let the registry hold both. Seat 3's rulings applied: F1 (`?package=` on the POST doors; clone's names the source), F2 (an additive `holders` in core; structured candidates on `/data` are #32250), F3 (a named non-holder refused at any holder count, a column-only bind included). The epic seat's M5 conditions (comment 6770072902): nothing the old key refused is admitted, pinned per dialect with a NULL and a non-NULL organization; a re-runnable migration that guesses no package and names the duplicates; driver-memory measured and pinned as a declared limit. ## Tests - `plugin-security/src/grant-permission-set-package.test.ts` (new, 13): a real `ObjectQL` over SQLite with the grant-name hook and the stamp seam registered as the plugin registers them, over a stand-in registry holding one set in two packages. Two holders: no package is 409 with both candidates (envelope and `/data` wire), a holder is stored, a non-holder is 409; F3: one holder with another package named, an environment-only set with a package named, and a column-only bind; updates: an echo, a non-system package value, a rename. CONTROLs: one holder, no package or the holder, stored stamped; a name nothing holds stays `400 reference_not_found`. - `plugin-security/src/granted-by-writer-provenance.test.ts`: three pins that encoded the re-stamp now assert F3; the BASE answer is kept in comments. - `plugin-security/src/grant-permission-set-name.test.ts`: the duplicate-grant describe boots the guard; a new CONTROL shows two package-less grants admitted without it. - `runtime/src/domains/permission-set-package-doors.test.ts` (new, 14): both doors through `HttpDispatcher.handleSecurity` over the real catalog reader. Two holders: 409 with structured candidates, `?package=` a holder addresses exactly that set (activation writes its ledger row; clone copies it into its pair), a non-holder is 409, closed query sets are 400, a two-holder target is taken. BOUNDARY: one ledger row per `(type, name)`. CONTROLs: one holder answers as before. - `metadata-protocol/src/migrations/user-permission-set-packageless-index.test.ts` (new) on real SQLite: the hole before the guard, the guard created, packaged rows outside it, condition 1 side by side with an old-key database (non-NULL and NULL organization), idempotent, a conflict naming the keys with no row touched and re-runnable after the duplicate is removed, ten keys then "and N more", the MySQL and MariaDB statement arms, and the #21418 classification sentinel. Live twins: `….live-postgres.test.ts` (run here against PostgreSQL 16) and `….live-mysql.test.ts` (CI). - `metadata-protocol/src/migrations/runtime-index-preflight.test.ts`, `cli/src/commands/migrate/duplicates.contract.test.ts`, `types/src/driver-error-classification.callers.test.ts`: the roster entries. - `driver-sql/src/sql-driver-widened-grant-key.test.ts` (new): an old-key database booted by this declaration keeps the old key until the guard stands, then gets one safe replace; inserts answer per condition 1; the organization column is NOT NULL on a table driver-sql builds. The 18.0 NULL-safe narrower over a nullable organization: never an orphan drop, certified or not; read before the package column exists, kept; not certified, kept beside the guard and still folding NULL-organization grants; certified, kept until the guard stands, then one safe replace naming it. - Dogfood: `stored-reference-package-column.dogfood.test.ts`'s forged-column CONTROL asserts the engine now refuses the forge (F3) and writes it below the engine; `upgrade-18x-index-equivalence.dogfood.test.ts` pins the grant index's retirement on the restored 18.0 store as one safe replace. - `driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-user-permission-set-packageless.test.ts` (new): the index spec and filter, the old key retired only after the guard, a CONTROL collection; a real-mongod suite (skipped here). - `driver-memory/src/memory-user-permission-set-packageless.test.ts` (new): the declared limit. - `core/src/security/security-catalog.test.ts`: `holders` on a refusal, in candidate order. ## Acceptance notes - **The ledger stays name-keyed (ADR-0150 red line 3).** `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive` addresses a row by `(metadata_type, name)`, and every reader of a permission set's ledger row is name-keyed, so after `?package=HR` writes HR's row, a flip naming CRM re-addresses that one row to CRM. Pinned as a BOUNDARY in the doors test and stated in `catalog-activation.ts`'s doc and the changeset. Per-package rows need package-keyed ledger readers, which this card does not touch. - **Structured candidates on `/data`** are #32250: the grant's refusal there carries the D3 sentence naming every holder, and the thrown error carries `.refusal.candidates`. - **driver-memory, a declared limit.** It has no raw-SQL seam and no runtime-owned uniques, so no guard is built (the activation ledger's guard has the same exemption). Measured: its unique check treats a NULL as distinct, so two package-less grants of one set for one user in one organization are admitted where the old key refused the second. `memory-user-permission-set-packageless.test.ts` asserts the admission, so a future guard there turns it red on purpose. - **Upgrading SQL databases.** The old index keeps refusing what it refused until a sync that runs safe drift (dev `autoMigrate: 'safe'`, or `os migrate apply`) replaces it, after the guard stands. On an 18.0 database that index is in the NULL-safe COALESCE form: it is retired only on a certified table, whose tenant column holds no NULL (every database this release boots is certified: its birth marker or the ownership ceremony's), and kept everywhere else. - **A hash-shadow-carried narrower (MySQL, MariaDB) is still not matched by the widening arm**, as on `main` (the activation ledger's arm has the same rule): if an upgraded MySQL or MariaDB database carries the grant's old key through a `__hash` shadow, the differ reports it as an orphan `drop_index` (destructive, opt-in) rather than offering a safe replace. Not measured here (no MySQL in this container; the live MySQL suite is CI's). Out of scope here; seat 3 files it. - **Two-holder answers are unreachable on a real registry until #31698 PR-2**, so every two-holder test uses a stand-in registry; every one-holder answer is what a real environment answers today. ## Verification **Dogfood battery** (`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test'`, the whole suite, never a filtered subset): - **First run, on `c03443b72`: red, 3 of 449 files.** Each was a real finding, and each is fixed in this PR: 1. `stored-reference-package-column.dogfood.test.ts`, the forged-column CONTROL. It forged `permission_set_package` through the engine as a system writer, which F3 now refuses. The CONTROL now asserts that refusal (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / `refused` / `not-held-by-qualifier`, rows unchanged), then forges the column below the engine (knex) and keeps its old assertions across a restart. 2. `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts`, "HEAD's schema plan over it holds no destructive change", and 3. `upgrade-18x-index-equivalence.dogfood.test.ts`, "zero recreate_index and zero destructive drift". On the restored 18.0 store the grant's old index is in the NULL-safe COALESCE form, and the widening arm did not recognize it (and the plan reads before `permission_set_package` exists), so the differ offered it as an orphan `drop_index`, destructive. Fixed in `driver-sql` (`ae6343780`, What changes); the equivalence test now pins the retirement as one safe replace. Targeted rerun of those three files after the fix: 3 files, 34 tests passed. - **Final run, on `ae6343780`: green.** `Test Files 446 passed | 3 skipped (449)`, `Tests 3725 passed | 42 skipped (3767)`, `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0` (32m42s). - The two commits after it change no source, test or fixture the battery runs, so its result stands for this head: `fa0d46cab` touches `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (a census row and the regenerated register) and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (a ledger row), and `72f0a6848` touches the changeset's declaration lines. The gates those files feed were re-run on each (Gates).
Ablations (each mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with git diff HEAD empty) | Leg | Mutation (source, on the committed head) | Suites run | Red | Green | |---|---|---|---|---| | A | `stored-permission-set-package-stamp.ts`: `if (packageHolders.includes(named)) return;` → `… \|\| 'ablated-1') return;` (F3 at the seam off) | the three grant suites (67 tests) | 5: every F3 case for a system writer and the column-only bind | 62, the two-holder no-package refusal and every CONTROL included | | B | `grant-permission-set-name.ts`: a two-holder refusal answered as `not-found` (main's reading) | the same | 1: two holders, no package, now `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` | 66 | | C | `schema-drift.ts`: the NULL-safe narrower match off | `sql-driver-widened-grant-key`, `-widened-declared-unique`, `-tenant-key-equivalence` (38) | 5: every 18.0 NULL-safe leg | 32 (1 skipped) | | D | `schema-drift.ts`: an absent gained column disqualifies the arm again (main's rule) | the same | 1: the plan read before the sync | 36 (1 skipped) | | E | the three runtime door files and the three grant files restored to `main` `e40f2df2` (the whole change) | `permission-set-package-doors.test.ts` (14), `grant-permission-set-package.test.ts` (13) | 11 and 6: every two-holder, `?package=`, closed-query and F3 case | 3 and 7: the one-holder CONTROLs | Every mutated leg is restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty, printed by the tool or by the script's `git status --porcelain`).

Gates **Derived gates** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe): - On `ae6343780` the list derived 113 commands; 111 exited 0.
